verdict.rationale: The evidence shows you can run your own distribution layer. Teams can add local or repo marketplace sources (`codex plugin marketplace add`), and "local and repo marketplaces" are documented as separate authoring, testing and team-distribution sources. The official catalog is a public JSON manifest on GitHub, and a probe confirmed its skills are plain portable folders that third-party tooling can install. However, the universal plugin directory, the review and publication pipeline, and the ChatGPT/Codex host surfaces that run plugins are all OpenAI-operated, with no documented way to self-host them. Local marketplace availability also "can vary by surface." Missing for 10: a self-hostable plugin directory or registry and publishing backend, a self-hostable host runtime, deployment docs for running the system on your own infrastructure, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted setup.
